prompt: I want to model a university system with Students, Courses, and Professors. Students can enroll in many courses, professors teach courses. Each course has a name and credits. How do I do this in BESSER and then generate a SQLAlchemy ORM from it?

assertions.text: Uses correct imports from besser.BUML.metamodel.structural (DomainModel, Class, Property, etc.)
Defines 3 classes: Student, Course, Professor (or equivalent names)
Creates associations with correct multiplicities (many-to-many for student-course, one/many-to-many for professor-course)
Assembles a DomainModel with types and associations
Uses SQLAlchemyGenerator with correct import and invocation
Produced Python code is syntactically plausible (no hallucinated API calls)
